item.title: トランプ大統領、加ボンバルディア機の米国販売を認めないと主張
item.description:
Bhargav Acharya Allison Lampert
[７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は７日、カナダ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bhargav Acharya　Allison Lampert

[７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は７日、カナダのボンバルディア がプライベートジェット機を米国で生産しない限り、同社が米国で販売することを認めないと主張した。自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で「ボンバルディアの米国での販売をこれ以上許さない！　彼らの製品の質は十分ではない！」とし、「わが国の市場を望むならばここで製造し、アメリカを『貯金箱』のように扱うのをやめなければならない」と訴えた。

カナダはトランプ政権による輸入品への追加関税に反発し、貿易紛争に発展した。８日には米国からの輸入品に対する報復関税を発動し、対抗する。

ホワイトハウスは、米連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）の型式証明を受けているボンバルディアのプライベートジェット機の販売を差し止めるため、どのような措置を講じるかのコメント要請に即座には回答しなかった。ボンバルディアの製品は、第１次トランプ政権が主導して締結した米国・メキシコ・カナダ協定（ＵＳＭＣＡ）にも準拠している。

米国の航空宇宙アナリスト、リチャード・アブラフィア氏は、ボンバルディアのプライベートジェット機が搭載しているジェットエンジンの大部分は、米ハネウェル・エアロスペース とＧＥエアロスペース の両社が米国で製造していると指摘。その上で、ボンバルディアに発注した顧客がキャンセルすることはなく、トランプ氏が販売を阻止できるとも考えられないとの見方を示した。

ボンバルディアはカナダ東部モントリオールに本社を置き、米国で３５００人の従業員と、米国に拠点を置く２８００社のサプライヤーを抱えている。米国で６カ所目となるサービスセンターを新設し、南部テキサス州で主力機「グローバル８０００」の翼を生産している。

ボンバルディアはコメントの要請に直ちには回答しなかった。

item.title: 台湾ウィストロン、ＧＤＲ発行で15億ドル調達 原材料購入資金に
item.description:
Yantoultra Ngui Wen-Yee Lee
[香港／台北 ７日 ロイター] - 台湾の電子機器メーカー、緯...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yantoultra Ngui　Wen-Yee Lee

[香港／台北 ７日 ロイター] - 台湾の電子機器メーカー、緯創資通（ウィストロン） は、グローバル預託証券（ＧＤＲ）の価格を５８．８８ドルに設定し、世界的な発行を通じて１４億７０００万ドルを調達する。同社が７日に証券取引所に提出した書類で明らかにした。調達資金は外貨建ての原材料購入資金に充てるという。

ウィストロンは、台湾での生産能力拡大に向けた追加支出を承認しており、７月には米テキサス州に７億ドル規模の工場を開設し、エヌビディア の最新人工知能（ＡＩ）システムの製造を開始した。

ロイターはこれに先立ち、ウィストロンが１ＧＤＲ５８．６７─５９．７９ドルで２５００万ＧＤＲを発行すると報じていた。最終価格はこの価格帯の下限付近となった。

提出書類によると、ウィストロンは２億５０００万株の普通株式に相当する２５００万ＧＤＲを発行する予定。

１ＧＤＲはウィストロン株１０株に相当し、価格は約１８６．２４台湾ドル（５．９１米ドル）となる。これは、同社株の７日終値１９７台湾ドルを約５．５％下回っている。

ウィストロンは提出書類の中で、新株発行により既存株主の持分が７．２９％希薄化するとしたが、株主の持分に対する実質的な希薄化は予想されていないと説明した。

同社は８月、クラウドコンピューティング企業や法人顧客からのＡＩサーバー需要が引き続き供給を上回っていると述べていた。同社の第２・四半期の純利益は前年同期比１２８％増、売上高は６４％増となった。

item.title: 欧州通信4社、衛星・携帯直接通信で企業連合設立を協議＝報道
item.description: [７日 ロイター] - ドイツテレコム、オレンジ、ボーダフォン・グループ、テレフォニカの欧州通信大手４社が、欧州連合...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[７日 ロイター] - ドイツテレコム、オレンジ、ボーダフォン・グループ、テレフォニカの欧州通信大手４社が、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の衛星周波数の入札に参加して携帯電話への直接通信サービスを提供するコンソーシアム（企業連合）の設立に向けて、初期段階の協議を行っている。ブルームバーグが７日、事情に詳しい関係者の話として報じた。

報道によると、４社はＥＵが域内事業者向けに確保する方針を示している２ギガヘルツの周波数帯の割り当てを共同で落札することを目指す。この方針は、主権的な衛星通信能力の強化を狙ったもの。

コンソーシアム設立や入札計画についてはまだ最終決定されていないという。

ＥＵは今年５月、携帯電話サービス向けの貴重な衛星周波数帯の大部分を欧州企業に割り当て、米事業者が取得できる割合を減らす計画を発表した。域内企業を後押しし、巨大ＩＴ企業への依存を減らす狙いがある。

欧州委員会は、２９０機の衛星から成るＥＵの多軌道衛星群「ＩＲＩＳ２（アイリススクエア）」の周波数の３分の２を商用に割り当て、これをＥＵ域内事業者と域外事業者に均等に配分する。

コンソーシアムはこのうちＥＵ事業者向け枠に応札する見通し。

ＩＲＩＳ２は米スペースＸのスターリンクに対抗する欧州の取り組みで、欧州委員会に加え、ＳＥＳ、ユーテルサット、ヒスパサットで構成するコンソーシアムが主導している。

item.title: 英ジャガー・ランドローバー、従業員の1割弱を削減へ
item.description:
Sam Tabahriti
[ロンドン ７日 ロイター] - インド自動車大手タタ・モーターズ傘下の英ジャガー・ラン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sam Tabahriti

[ロンドン ７日 ロイター] - インド自動車大手タタ・モーターズ傘下の英ジャガー・ランドローバー（ＪＬＲ）は７日、今後２年間で希望退職を通じて従業員数の１割弱に当たる約４０００人を削減する経営再建策を発表した。中国企業との競争激化や、輸入品に対する関税の動きが逆風となっている。

ＪＬＲは経営再建策により、１７億ポンド（約２３億ドル）の経費削減と、損益分岐点を３０万台に引き下げることを目指すとした。

ＪＬＲは世界で約４万３０００人、うち英国で３万４０００人を雇用しており、英国に１７の拠点を設けている。ただ、どこで人員削減を実施するのかについては明らかにしなかった。

一方、今後１年間に５つの新製品を発売し、５年間にわたって電動化、デジタル技術、先進的な製造技術、および顧客体験向上に向けて１５０億―１８０億ポンドの投資を続けることも示した。

バラジ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「自動車業界は激しい競争や地政学的不安の中で技術革新が進むなど、重大な課題に直面している」とコメントした。

レイノルズ英商務相は７日にバラジ氏と話し、今週後半には同社および労働組合と会談する予定だ。

バーナム首相の報道官は「影響を受ける従業員と家族、そして地域社会全体にとって、これは不確実で不安な時期になることを理解している。現在の市場環境が、世界の自動車業界には厳しいことも承知している」とコメントした。

item.title: Shohei Ohtani back in lineup, but Dodgers have no pitching timetable
item.description: After getting a long weekend off to recover from nagging injuries, Shohei Ohtani will return to the Los Angeles Dodgers' lineup Monday in their series opener against the visiting Cincinnati Reds.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: After getting a long weekend off to recover from nagging injuries, Shohei Ohtani will return to the Los Angeles Dodgers' lineup Monday in their series opener against the visiting Cincinnati Reds. Ohtani was back in his usual leadoff spot as the designated hitter. He missed four games due to right biceps, left knee and neck ailments. As for Ohtani's role as a starting pitcher, manager Dave Roberts said before the game that the Dodgers have "no timetable for when he's going to pick up a baseball." Asked in a follow-up why the Dodgers have not ruled out the possibility Ohtani could return to the mound, Roberts merely replied, "I'm choosing not to say it's dead." A stint on the injured list was initially "on the table" for Ohtani. But before the Dodgers' game Sunday against Washington, Roberts told reporters Ohtani had made enough progress that he could return the following day. The Dodgers were eager to avoid an IL move, as Ohtani would have been required to go on the 15-day IL as a two-way player. He has not pitched since July 3. With 19 games left in the regular season, Ohtani may not even be back in the batting order full-time just yet, according to Roberts. "I don't want to say it's day to day, but I am very curious to see how he comes out of tonight to then make the decision for tomorrow and the ensuing days," Roberts said Monday. "We've put a pin in throwing and just kind of having him focus on the hitting, the running, keeping his legs good and doing whatever it takes to help us win." The four-time MVP has batted .279 with 30 home runs and 80 RBIs in 133 games this season. In the six games before his absence, he was 2-for-23 with 11 strikeouts. He hit his last homer on Aug. 18. --Field Level Media

item.title: UK retailers seek to create 100,000 jobs for young unemployed over next 3 years
item.description: British retailers said on Tuesday that they would seek to create 100,000 jobs for young people not in employment or education by the time of next national election due in 2029, as part of a government drive to stem a rise in youth employment.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British retailers said on Tuesday that they would seek to create 100,000 jobs for young people not in employment or education by the time of next national election due in 2029, as part of a government drive to stem a rise in youth employment. The British Retail Consortium trade body and the Department for Work and Pensions said they were also launching a new voluntary work placement programme for young people aged 18-24 that would help them get experience for permanent retail jobs. "Too many young people are trapped in a vicious cycle where they need experience to get a job and need a job to get experience – leaving them stuck while the world of work drifts further out of reach," Prime Minister Andy Burnham said in a statement announcing the programmes. Britain has just under 1 million young people aged 16-24 who are not in education, employment or training (NEET), and earlier in the year the number was its highest since 2013 Work placements of 2-4 weeks will be offered to young people aged 18-24 who are receiving unemployment benefits Retailers offering the work placements include Aldi, Amazon (AMZN.O) , Asda, JD Sports (JD.L) , John Lewis Partnership, Marks & Spencer (MKS.L) , Morrisons, Primark (ABF.L) , and Tesco (TSCO.L) Around 11,000 work placements will be available initially Some employer organisations have previously blamed increases in Britain's minimum wage and higher employer social security contributions for rising youth unemployment Retailers and their suppliers account for nearly a quarter of youth employment in Britain

item.title: UK retail sales growth slows to 4-month low in August, BRC says
item.description: British retail sales growth slowed to a four-month low in August as a surge driven by record-hot weather earlier in the summer faded, figures from the British Retail Consortium trade body showed on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British retail sales growth slowed to a four-month low in August as a surge driven by record-hot weather earlier in the summer faded, figures from the British Retail Consortium trade body showed on Tuesday. The BRC said that total retail sales grew by an annual 0.7% in August, down from 1.3% in July, while like-for-like growth — which adjusts for changing floorspace – slowed to 0.5% from 1%. "Summer spending started in May this year, as earlier higher temperatures pulled forward related purchases. And while the heat and holiday spending continued to drive food, drink, health and beauty sales into August, most other categories couldn't sustain another month of growth," said Linda Ellett, head of consumer, retail and leisure at survey sponsors KPMG. Food sales grew by an annual 2.6% in August, down from 3.8% in July and below the average growth over the past year Non-food sales fell by 0.8% in August after a 0.7% drop in July, weaker than the average 0.2% growth in the past year The BRC said shoppers cut back on big-ticket purchases such as furniture and household appliances in favour of cheaper health and beauty products BRC data is not adjusted for inflation and is based on sales recorded by major retailers between August 2 and August 29 Official retail sales data showed a slowdown in volumes growth to 1.6% in July from 3.8% in June Separate data from Barclays, also released on Tuesday, showed overall consumer spending grew 2.1% in August after a 2.0% rise in July Barclays also reported a fall in consumer confidence to 26% from July's 21-month high of 30%

item.title: Asia's next leverage-driven market crash could be brewing
item.description: South Korea's brutal summer equity rout showed how margin debt can turn a selloff into a market-wide tailspin. Korea's AI giants remain exposed, but the next Asian crash may follow different fault lines.
item.dc:creator: Manishi Raychaudhuri
item.content:encoded: South Korea's brutal [USN:L6N42X0X8 TEXT:"summer equity rout"] showed how margin debt can turn a selloff into a market-wide tailspin. Korea's AI giants remain exposed, but the next Asian crash may follow different fault lines. The sharp correction in South Korean equities, which saw the KOSPI (.KS11) collapse 39% from June 22 to July 30, has been widely attributed to the rapid buildup and subsequent unwinding of margin loans [USN:L4N43H0O3 TEXT:"held by retail investors"]. Driven by AI euphoria, millions of South Korean retail investors used broker loans to buy the equities of tech giants as well as highly volatile single-stock [USN:L4N43H0PK TEXT:"leveraged exchange-traded funds"] (ETFs). This helps explain how the KOSPI spiked 116% in the year through June 22. When tech shares tumbled in June on worries about the sustainability of AI capital spending, falling collateral values triggered widespread margin calls, or demands for additional cash or securities to cover losses. Lacking the cash to meet these demands, traders faced automatic, forced liquidations. Brokers dumped shares from over a million leveraged accounts , creating a self-reinforcing cascade that erased billions in market value even when fundamentals had not materially changed. Margin loans have also risen sharply in other Asian markets, raising major red flags. India's Margin Trading Facility (MTF) book has surged from just over $1 billion at the end of 2020 to $16.3 billion as of August 31, according to data from the National Stock Exchange and the Bombay Stock Exchange. Meanwhile, China's outstanding margin balance, according to Shanghai Stock Exchange data, has tripled from $68 billion at the beginning of 2019 to $200 billion as of August 31. And Japan's margin-loan balance has almost doubled from $18 billion at the beginning of 2020 to over $35 billion as of August 31, according to Japan Exchange Group. The question now is whether this means another major leverage-driven correction could be coming. SMALL BUT MIGHTY Today’s margin loan balance throughout Asia may appear modest as a proportion of total equity market capitalization. India’s and Japan’s represent just 0.3% and 0.45% of their respective market caps. However, when South Korea's margin balance was at its recent peak in late June of 38.7 trillion won ($28.75 billion), that represented barely 0.6% of the market's cap – and it still caused massive damage when it unwound. That makes the picture in China all the more concerning. China's Shanghai Stock Exchange margin balance of 1.34 trillion yuan ($200 billion), as of August 31, equates to 2% of its market cap, significantly higher than its peers. China's margin balance is also notable in that it is 8% higher than its previous peak in May 2015. That spike preceded a [USN:L5N10Z2P9 TEXT:"48% crash"] in the Shanghai Composite Index (.SSEC) over the next eight months. The comparison is not exact, of course, given changes in [USN:E20150705 TEXT:"market rules and regulatory oversight"] since then, but the scale of leverage remains a red flag. DIFFERENT POCKETS OF RISK Another major risk to examine is concentration. South Korea provided a stark lesson on the destructive power of concentrated margin loans. When the KOSPI margin balance reached its peak in the third week of June, Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) together accounted for 9.09 trillion won ($5.9 billion), representing nearly 31% of total KOSPI leverage. On the one hand, that is unsurprising, as the two companies make up over 30% of the highly concentrated KOSPI. But, nevertheless, this crowding still helps explain why Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix plummeted by such large amounts – 43% and 55%, respectively – when margin loans unwound. Margin loans in both China and India are also concentrated, though in very different areas. Chinese traders, like their Korean counterparts, have channelled leveraged capital primarily into large-cap electronics, semiconductor and telecoms stocks. Given the enormous size of many of these firms, a rapid unraveling of margin loans could have a huge market impact. Japan's margin loan profile seems to mirror Korea's mania for large-cap technology titans. Data from the Japan Exchange Group indicates that margin buying is primarily concentrated in semiconductor and electronic component names such as Kioxia Holdings (285A.T) , Murata Manufacturing (6981.T) , Tokyo Electron (8035.T) and Ibiden (4062.T) . Indian retail traders, on the other hand, have allocated a significantly greater share of their margin capital to small- and mid-cap stocks. According to data from NSE and BSE, 55% of Indian margin loans are in micro-, small- and mid-cap stocks. In a sharp selloff, investors may be forced to sell larger, more liquid stocks to meet margin calls, amplifying the impact of the correction. TREADING CAREFULLY It’s important to note that regulators have noticed the growing risk posed by margin loans and are acting. South Korea’s Financial Services Commission [USN:P8N433043 TEXT:"this month unveiled several measures"] to curb highly volatile single-stock ETFs. India’s RBI in July banned the use of Loans Against Shares (LAS) for buying securities or applying for IPOs. The China Securities Regulatory Commission in January also raised the [USN:P8N3TJ0DV TEXT:"minimum margin requirement to 100%"] for new margin accounts. These changes haven’t eliminated the risk, but simply stopped it from metastasizing. Moreover, the attractiveness of margin loans depends critically on borrowing costs. It’s no surprise that Korean equities tumbled after the Bank of Korea [USN:L1N42J1AC TEXT:"warned about rate hikes in June"]. And interest rates in much of the region – with the glaring exception of China – appear to be heading up. For investors, navigating Asian equities in this high-leverage era will require close vigilance: the next margin-driven fault line may not replicate South Korea's footprint, but could instead target the unique pockets of leverage quietly compounding across the region. (The views expressed here are those of Manishi Raychaudhuri , the founder and CEO of Emmer Capital Partners Ltd and the former head of Asia-Pacific Equity Research at BNP Paribas Securities.) Enjoying this column? Check out Reuters Open Interest (ROI), your essential new source for global financial commentary. Follow ROI on LinkedIn, and X. And listen to the Morning Bid daily podcast on Apple , Spotify , or the Reuters app . Subscribe to hear Reuters journalists discuss the biggest news in markets and finance seven days a week. ($1 = 6.7108 Chinese yuan renminbi)

item.title: Cardinals optimistic rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) will play in opener
item.description: The Arizona Cardinals are hopeful rookie running back Jeremiyah Love will be available when they open the season against the host Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Arizona Cardinals are hopeful rookie running back Jeremiyah Love will be available when they open the season against the host Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday. Love, the No. 3 overall pick, sustained a high ankle sprain in a preseason game against the Las Vegas Raiders on Aug. 13 and neither played nor practiced the rest of the preseason. With the season opener six days away, the Cardinals conducted a walk-through on Monday and Love participated. "Progressing," LaFleur told reporters of Love. "He was out there moving around today. We'll see on Wednesday. I'll have a better idea for all those (injured) guys." Love is forecasted to be an immediate standout after being a college star at Notre Dame. He rushed for 58 yards on 11 carries and caught three passes for 14 yards against the Raiders before the injury. Arizona has just three running backs on its current 53-man roster. The other two are Tyler Allgeier and Bam Knight. The Cardinals have Evan Hull on their practice squad. --Field Level Media

item.title: ドイツ銀、AIインフラ融資のリスク移転でSRT活用へ－約3600億円対象
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ドイツ銀行は、AI関連インフラ向け融資のリスクを抑えるため、「重大リスク移転（SRT）」の活用に乗り出す。欧米の金融機関でも同様の動きが広がっている。

ドイツ銀は、データセンター向け融資を含む約20億ユーロ（約3600億円）のプロジェクトファイナンス債権を対象とするSRTを準備している。事情に詳しい複数の関係者が取引の非公開を理由に匿名で明らかにした。取引条件は投資家との協議後に変更される可能性があるという。ドイツ銀がプロジェクトファイナンスのポートフォリオを対象にSRTを実施するのは初めて。

同業ではソシエテ・ジェネラル、INGグループ、スペインのバンコ・ビルバオ・ビスカヤ・アルヘンタリア（BBVA）などが、データセンター事業向け融資などを含むSRTを検討または実施している。BNPパリバ、ロイヤル・バンク・オブ・カナダ（RBC）、トロント・ドミニオン銀行（TD）なども、AI関連インフラに特化した取引を検討している。

コンサルティング会社プライスウォーターハウスクーパース（PwC）の推計によると、AI需要の拡大を背景に世界のデータセンター支出は2050年までに31兆6000億ドル（約4880兆円）に達する見通しだ。地元住民や環境保護活動家からの反発が強まっているものの、 マイクロソフトやアマゾン･ドット･コムなどの巨大IT企業のほか、中小のデータセンター事業者も新施設の整備を進めている。

こうした投資ブームと並行して、SRTの需要も旺盛だ。SRTは、投資家が融資ポートフォリオのデフォルト（債務不履行）リスクの一部を引き受けることで、2桁のリターンを得る仕組みだ。銀行はリスク加重資産を圧縮し、株主還元や追加融資の余力を確保する手段として、SRTの活用を拡大している。投資会社クレセント・キャピタル・グループは、今年のSRT売却額が過去最高の450億ドルに達すると予想している。

item.title: 中国人民銀、8月の金購入は23年10月以来最大 6カ月連続拡大
item.description: [北京／上海 ７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[北京／上海 ７日 ロイター] - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）が７日発表したデータによると、８月の金購入は６カ月連続で拡大し、購入量は２０２３年１０月以来最大となった。金購入は２２カ月連続。

８月末の金保有量は７６７３万トロイオンスと、７月末の７６０８万トロイオンスから増加した。

増加分の６５万オンス（約２０．２トンに相当）は７月の６４万オンスをやや上回り、月間の増加量としては、保有量が７４万オンス増えた２３年１０月以来の大きさとなった。

人民銀が１６万オンスを買い増した３月以降、購入ペースは加速している。６月の増加分は４８万オンスだった。

金準備は７月末の３０６３億５０００万ドルから、８月末には３５００億８０００万ドルに急増した。新たな購入と金価格上昇の双方を反映した。

金価格は８月に９．７％上昇し、月間の上昇率としては１月以来の大きさとなった。ドル安、米国債利回りの低下、安全資産としての需要が支援材料となった。

ただ、月末にかけて金価格は下落圧力にさらされた。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォーシュ議長がタカ派的な姿勢を示し、米利上げ観測が再燃したことが背景。

item.title: キューバ、封鎖の打撃深刻でも米国との交渉しない＝外相
item.description:
Ayose Naranjo
[ハバナ ７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ayose Naranjo

[ハバナ ７日 ロイター] - キューバのロドリゲス外相は７日の記者会見で、米国との間で進行中の協議はなく、今後の交渉の予定もないと述べた。ただ、連絡を取り合う意思は依然としてあるとも語った。

ロドリゲス氏は、数十年にわたる米国による対キューバ貿易禁輸措置による損害額が、２０２５年だけで前年比７％増の８１億ドルに達したと述べ、「ジェノサイド（集団虐殺）」に等しいと主張した。

また、トランプ政権がキューバに対して石油禁輸措置を課した結果、石油生産が事実上壊滅状態に陥り、現在では数日にわたる全国的な停電が発生していることから、今年に入ってキューバ経済への打撃はさらに深刻化するだろうと述べた。

「封鎖は政府を罰するものではなく、全ての国民にあらゆる面で苦痛を与えている」とし、「１日２─３時間かそれ以下しか電力が使えない状態で長期間過ごすこと、食料が腐ること、暑さで眠れないこと、子どもたちがほぼ暗闇の中で宿題をすることを意味する」と語った。

米国務省は、ロドリゲス氏の発言に関するコメント要請に直ちには回答しなかった。

item.title: Rybakina derrota Osaka e chega às quartas de final do Aberto dos EUA
item.description: Elena Rybakina superou mais um grande obstáculo na busca pelo terceiro título de Grand Slam ao derrotar a ex-campeã do Aberto dos EUA, Naomi Osaka, por 6-1 e 6-4 nesta segunda-feira, garantindo assim sua vaga nas quartas de final em Flushing Meadows.
item.dc:creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
item.content:encoded: Elena Rybakina superou mais um grande obstáculo na busca pelo terceiro título de Grand Slam ao derrotar a ex-campeã do Aberto dos EUA, Naomi Osaka, por 6-1 e 6-4 nesta segunda-feira, garantindo assim sua vaga nas quartas de final em Flushing Meadows. A vitória impecável de Rybakina, que venceu Wimbledon em 2022 e o Aberto da Austrália deste ano, garantiu um confronto nas quartas de final com a campeã olímpica Zheng Qinwen e deixou a cazaque a apenas uma vitória de se tornar a número um do mundo pela primeira vez. “É claro que eu quero. Não conheço ninguém que não desejasse isso. É definitivamente um dos meus objetivos”, disse Rybakina, logo após chegar às suas primeiras quartas de final em Nova York. “Vou tentar encarar (a partida) da mesma forma e dar o meu melhor. Lutar até o fim na minha próxima partida. Vamos ver o que vai acontecer. “Se eu sacar tão bem quanto hoje, acho que tenho todas as chances. Vou dar o meu melhor. Espero que as coisas corram a meu favor.” Rybakina, segunda cabeça de chave, venceu o primeiro set em 22 minutos, convertendo duas de suas três oportunidades de quebra antes de selar a vitória com um saque potente contra a bicampeã de Nova York, Osaka, no Estádio Louis Armstrong. “A Naomi é uma adversária difícil. Eu sabia que, independentemente do placar, precisava me concentrar em cada bola, pois tudo pode mudar rapidamente." (Reportagem de Shrivathsa Sridhar, em Nova York)

item.title: Riley Greene, Kevin McGonigle help Tigers top Twins to open series
item.description: Riley Greene had three hits, including a two-run home run, and the host Detroit Tigers held off the Minnesota Twins 5-4 on Monday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Riley Greene had three hits, including a two-run home run, and the host Detroit Tigers held off the Minnesota Twins 5-4 on Monday afternoon. Greene's homer was his third over the last three games and his sixth extra-base hit during that span. Kevin McGonigle also homered for the Tigers, while Colt Keith added an RBI. Tigers starter Troy Melton (8-4) gave up four runs and seven hits in 5 2/3 innings while picking up the win. Detroit's maligned bullpen held the Twins (68-76) scoreless the rest of the way. Jacob Waguespack, Drew Sommers and Kenley Jansen each tossed an inning of scoreless relief, with Jansen collecting his 18th save. The Tigers (66-78) had lost three of their last four games in walk-off fashion at Cleveland over the weekend. Twins starter Joe Ryan (6-9) gave up three runs (two earned) and three hits in four innings while recording seven strikeouts. Ryan was activated prior to the game from the injured list and made his first start since Aug. 4 after recovering from a strained left glute muscle. Connor Prielipp finished out the contest, allowing Greene's homer among five hits while notching five strikeouts. Walker Jenkins had a two-run double for Minnesota, while Trevor Larnach smashed a solo homer and scored twice. Luke Keaschall reached base three times and scored a run. After Ryan Jeffers knocked in the Twins' first run on a first-inning fielder's choice, McGonigle homered in the bottom half off a Ryan fastball. Detroit made it 3-1 in the second inning. Zach McKinstry led off with a triple and Max Clark drew a one-out walk. Ryan then hit John Peck and Colt Keith on consecutive pitches, forcing in a run. An error by first baseman Royce Lewis on McGonigle's grounder allowed Clark to score. Larnach homered in the fourth, but Greene answered in the fifth with a 417-foot shot over the right field wall after Gleyber Torres reached on a single. Jenkins' double in the sixth cut the Tigers' lead to one, but the Twins failed to push across a tying run. --Field Level Media

item.title: Noah Lyles (hamstring) drops out of World Athletics Ultimate Championship
item.description: Olympic gold medalist Noah Lyles will sit out of the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship due to a hamstring injury that led to other health issues.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Olympic gold medalist Noah Lyles will sit out of the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship due to a hamstring injury that led to other health issues. Lyles, who won the 100-meter gold medal at the 2024 Paris Olympics and posted the world's fastest 100 this year (9.79 seconds) at U.S. Nationals, will miss out on a chance to win $150,000 in each of his sprint specialties. The World Athletics Ultimate Championship, a $10 million event designed to be the premier event for track and field competitors between Olympics, runs Friday through Sunday in Budapest, Hungary. The invite-only meet will feature just 16 competitors in each track event, eight in each field event and eight teams for relay. The gold medalist in each event earns $150,000. Lyles, 29, used his X account to announce his absence, which was triggered when he tweaked his left hamstring during the 200 final in July at U.S. Nationals. "It's been kind of complicated," Lyles said. "We thought it was very simple. Unfortunately, after running at USAs, I found out I had a small strain. Not very serious. And the rehab that we were putting together was going extremely well. Unfortunately, because of the strain, it caused some other things to flare up -- and it's made it hard for me to continue practicing." --Field Level Media

item.title: ヘッジファンド大物ロコス氏、英国離れギリシャへ－富裕層の流出続く
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ヘッジファンド創業者のクリス・ロコス氏が英国を離れることが分かった。英国有数の高額納税者で金融界の大物が同国を去る。

事情に詳しい複数の関係者によると、ロコス・キャピタル・マネジメントの創業者である同氏は、居住地をギリシャへ移す。非公表の情報であることを理由に匿名を条件に明かした関係者の1人によれば、同氏は移住に伴いアテネにオフィスを開設するという。

ロコス・キャピタルは約220億ドル（約3兆4000億円）を運用する。同社の広報担当者はコメントを控えた。

同氏の動きは、一定の外国人を対象に国外所得への税額を年間10万ユーロ（約1800万円）の定額とする制度を整えたギリシャにとって大きな勝利となる。一方で、英国にとっては痛手だ。

英国では、長年続いていた「ノン・ドム（英国非永住者）」向け優遇税制の廃止に加え、プライベート・エクイティ（PE、未公開株）投資から相続、キャピタルゲインに至るまで課税が強化された。これを受け、著名な金融関係者や企業経営者の国外移住が相次いでおり、ロコス氏もその1人となる。スター・トレーダーとして知られる同氏は、英サンデー・タイムズ紙が発表した最新の高額納税者の年次ランキングで3位に入り、納税額は3億3000万ポンド（約690億円）に達していた。

今回の動きは、ヒーリー新財務相が就任後初の予算案を発表する準備を進める中で明らかになった。金融市場では英国財政の脆弱（ぜいじゃく）性を巡る不安が高まっている。

ヒーリー財務相は7日に行った就任後初の主要演説で、英国を「富が創造される国」にしたいと述べ、企業の負担軽減を約束したものの、減税には踏み込まなかった。また、7月にスターマー前首相の後任として就任したバーナム首相はこれまで、キャピタルゲインや土地を含めた富への課税強化を支持する姿勢を示している。

ヒーリー氏の初予算案発表は10月28日に予定されている。世界的な債券市場の売りで、3月時点で財政ルールに対して確保していた236億ポンドの余裕の約半分が失われており、予算編成は難しい試練となる見通しだ。中東での紛争を受けて財政見通しが悪化し、銀行や石油、資産への増税を巡る観測が再び浮上している。

item.title: Zheng se mantiene firme tras varios altibajos en el Abierto de EEUU
item.description: Zheng Qinwen, en una trayectoria de altibajos, alcanzó los cuartos de final del Abierto de Estados Unidos el lunes, tras dar la sorpresa al derrotar a las campeonas de Grand Slam Madison Keys e Iga Swiatek en dos partidos consecutivos, en lo que supone el inicio de una épica remontada en su carrera.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Zheng Qinwen, en una trayectoria de altibajos, alcanzó los cuartos de final del Abierto de Estados Unidos el lunes, tras dar la sorpresa al derrotar a las campeonas de Grand Slam Madison Keys e Iga Swiatek en dos partidos consecutivos, en lo que supone el inicio de una épica remontada en su carrera. Hace dos años, todo le sonreía a la china Zheng: lucía la medalla de oro olímpica al cuello, había alcanzado su primera final de Grand Slam en el Abierto de Australia y se había colado entre las diez primeras del ranking. Pero una lesión crónica en el codo frenó en seco su progresión, ya que quedó eliminada de Wimbledon en primera ronda en 2025 antes de someterse a una intervención quirúrgica. Tras una sombría temporada de 2026 plagada de eliminaciones tempranas, incluidas derrotas en primera ronda en Roland Garros y en el All England Club, cayó hasta el puesto 121 del ránking y se vio obligada a pasar por la fase de clasificación en Nueva York. "Psicológicamente, es muy difícil de aceptar. Quiero decir, solía estar entre las diez primeras, era campeona olímpica. He jugado en los grandes estadios desde el principio", contó Zheng. "Es un proceso muy, muy duro. He sufrido mucho y he pasado por un gran dolor con cada una de las derrotas que he sufrido. Pero creo que, al final, en el deporte, solo hay que mantenerse humilde y seguir luchando, porque, una vez que pierdes eso, el resultado lo dice todo". El poder de su pensamiento positivo ha quedado plenamente de manifiesto en Nueva York. Superó un 0-5 en contra en el set decisivo contra Keys, finalista en 2017, en tercera ronda, y venció a otra rival de peso, Swiatek, en cuarta ronda, remontando un 0-5 en contra en el primer set. Zheng se enfrentará ahora a la segunda cabeza de serie, Elena Rybakina.

item.title: Paris investiga alegação de que mulheres foram escondidas de delegação hindu na Torre Eiffel
item.description: Funcionárias da Torre Eiffel foram solicitadas a se afastar do local durante uma visita de uma delegação religiosa hindu no fim de semana, segundo representantes sindicais, o que gerou um protesto dos funcionários e uma investigação pelas autoridades municipais de Paris.
item.dc:creator: Lewis Macdonald, Clotaire Achi
item.content:encoded: Funcionárias da Torre Eiffel foram solicitadas a se afastar do local durante uma visita de uma delegação religiosa hindu no fim de semana, segundo representantes sindicais, o que gerou um protesto dos funcionários e uma investigação pelas autoridades municipais de Paris. O monumento foi fechado na noite de segunda-feira enquanto os funcionários realizavam uma reunião sobre o incidente, que causou indignação entre a equipe e gerou críticas de políticos franceses. No sábado, uma delegação de cerca de 100 pessoas ligadas ao grupo hindu Bochasanwasi Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha, ou BAPS, fez uma visita privada à Torre Eiffel. “Enquanto a delegação passava, as mulheres foram solicitadas a deixar seus postos de trabalho para que os homens pudessem ocupar seus lugares”, disse Diane Davoine, representante sindical, à Reuters. “As tensões aumentaram no fim de semana, então, nesta manhã, os funcionários decidiram se reunir: primeiro, para iniciar um diálogo com a administração e, segundo, para garantir que as mulheres nunca mais sejam tratadas dessa forma na empresa”, disse ela. Na segunda-feira, placas na base da torre exibiam a seguinte mensagem: “A abertura da Torre Eiffel está atrasada por motivos operacionais.” Davoine disse que a direção pediu desculpas à equipe pelo incidente. O prefeito de Paris, Emmanuel Grégoire, afirmou que uma investigação seria iniciada “o mais rápido possível”. Em uma postagem na rede social X, ele disse estar ciente da indignação dos funcionários e concordou que a insatisfação deles era legítima. “É urgente que se esclareçam todos os fatos que levaram a esse protesto”, escreveu Grégoire. A BAPS, cujos representantes estavam na França para as comemorações relacionadas à inauguração de um templo hindu nos subúrbios de Paris, afirmou em comunicado que a visita à Torre Eiffel foi agendada no início do horário de funcionamento para evitar transtornos aos demais visitantes, devido ao tamanho de sua delegação. “Pelo que sabemos, em nenhum momento alguém foi impedido de acessar a Torre Eiffel. No entanto, pedimos sinceras desculpas por qualquer transtorno ou incômodo causado”, dizia o comunicado. Um porta-voz da SETE, empresa que administra o monumento, não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. (Reportagem de Lewis Macdonald, Clotaire Achi e Michaela Cabrera; Texto de Makini Brice)

item.title: Southeast Asia emerges as a crucial driver of China's clean-tech exports
item.description: Southeast Asian nations have emerged as key drivers of China's clean-energy export boom, with the region making record purchases of energy storage batteries, grid equipment, electric vehicles and clean-power generation components so far this year.
item.dc:creator: Gavin Maguire
item.content:encoded: Southeast Asian nations have emerged as key drivers of China's clean-energy export boom, with the region making record purchases of energy storage batteries, grid equipment, electric vehicles and clean-power generation components so far this year. In total, countries within the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) have splashed out over $20 billion on Chinese-made clean-tech products so far in 2026, according to energy think tank Ember. That spend total is 50% more than in the same period a year ago, and has solidified Southeast Asia's place as the largest market within Asia for Chinese-made clean-tech components. The Southeast Asian demand surge matters because, while Europe has been the chief destination for China's clean-tech exports in recent years, ASEAN clearly represents the next frontier and could offer Chinese exporters a years-long demand boom for their products. BROAD-BASED DEMAND ON CHINA'S DOORSTEP ASEAN's demand for China's exports runs the gamut of clean-tech systems. Year-to-date purchases of batteries, grid components, heating and cooling equipment, EVs and solar arrays have all scaled record highs this year. This broad-based demand will be a welcome development for Chinese exporters, which have relied heavily on advanced economies in recent years but are facing [USN:L1N44R07N TEXT:"rising trade tensions"] in Europe and North America that may slow future growth. In contrast, development trends across Southeast Asia suggest that sustained demand growth for Chinese-made equipment will continue as electricity use, industrial activity and energy investments all move higher. The region's economies continue to urbanize, industrialize and digitize at an accelerating rate. Governments are building renewable-energy capacity, expanding power grids, encouraging EV adoption and strengthening domestic manufacturing sectors. Each of those goals requires the same products that China now produces at unmatched scale: solar panels, batteries, EVs and power equipment. As a result, Southeast Asia is helping to absorb a growing share of China's clean-tech output at a time when access to some developed markets is becoming more uncertain. SOLAR SHINES Export data on solar systems provide one of the clearest examples of Southeast Asia's importance to China's manufacturers. Collectively, ASEAN nations have spent $4.1 billion so far this year on imports of Chinese-made solar arrays, which marks a nearly 90% jump from the same months in 2025. ASEAN accounted for 57% of China's total solar exports across Asia, making the region a critical market for its solar sector. Standout buyers include the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia and Vietnam, which have all roughly doubled their spending on solar imports so far in 2026 compared with a year earlier. Several Southeast Asian nations also dialled up spending to record highs on battery and grid imports, with the region spending just under $7 billion on energy-storage batteries and around $1.6 billion on grid components. An additional $1.2 billion was spent on imports of heating and cooling systems, while the region also brought in $6.3 billion worth of EVs. WIDER IMPACT The widespread uptick in demand for clean-energy components across Southeast Asia has repercussions beyond China's manufacturing base. Emissions trajectories will increasingly be shaped by developing economies with rising populations, expanding industrial sectors and growing electricity needs. And Southeast Asia — with a total population of roughly 700 million, according to ASEANstats.org — is one of the fastest-growing economic blocs globally, with annual gross domestic product (GDP) growth pegged at around 5%. That economic momentum requires steadily expanding power consumption, and coal currently accounts for a majority of the region's power mix, according to data from Ember. Yet every additional shipment of solar modules, batteries, EVs and grid equipment into Southeast Asia potentially accelerates the deployment of lower-carbon energy systems across one of the world's fastest-growing economic regions. The clean-tech story is therefore no longer simply about where products are made. It is also about where they are being used. By this metric, Southeast Asia is becoming one of the most important regions in the global energy transition. Its clean-tech imports are growing faster than the global market. Its share of Asian demand continues to rise. And its appetite spans every major segment of the clean-energy economy. As China searches for markets capable of absorbing its vast clean-tech output, no region is becoming more important than Southeast Asia. (The opinions expressed here are those of the author , a columnist for Reuters.) Enjoying this column? Check out Reuters Open Interest (ROI), your essential new source for global financial commentary. Follow ROI on LinkedIn and X . And listen to the Morning Bid daily podcast on Apple , Spotify , or the Reuters app . Subscribe to hear Reuters journalists discuss the biggest news in markets and finance seven days a week.

item.title: Giants release longtime starting WR Darius Slayton
item.description: The New York Giants released wide receiver Darius Slayton, their longest-tenured player, on Monday with six days before the season opener.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New York Giants released wide receiver Darius Slayton, their longest-tenured player, on Monday with six days before the season opener. Slayton was entering his eighth year with the Giants, who drafted him in the fifth round in 2019. He had started 78 of his 106 career games for the franchise, spanning head coaches Pat Shurmur, Joe Judge and Brian Daboll. Slayton recently told the Trentonian he was looking forward to what new coach John Harbaugh was instilling in New York. "I think we've been well-prepared," Slayton told the newspaper. "I think we've been well-acclimated, conditioned to be able to play football. And I think our mindset and the mentality that we've kind of adopted from Coach (Harbaugh), I think he's done a good job of having his imprint on this team. And I think that'll show during the season." Instead, the Giants will embark on the Harbaugh era without Slayton. Third-year star Malik Nabers, free agent signing Darnell Mooney, third-round rookie Malachi Fields and longtime Giants star Odell Beckham Jr. are the only four receivers left on the active roster before Sunday's opener against the Dallas Cowboys. Slayton, 29, had signed a three-year, $36 million contract with the Giants last year. Releasing him now saves the team $2.5 million, per reports. Slayton appeared in 14 games (12 starts) last year and caught 37 passes for 538 yards and one touchdown. He has career totals of 296 receptions, 4,435 yards and 22 TDs. --Field Level Media

item.title: Rybakina arrolla a Osaka y se clasifica para los cuartos de final del Abierto de EEUU
item.description: Elena Rybakina superó otro gran obstáculo en su camino hacia un tercer título de Grand Slam al imponerse con claridad a la excampeona del Abierto de Estados Unidos Naomi Osaka, por 6-1 y 6-4, este lunes, lo que le valió el pase a cuartos de final en Flushing Meadows.
item.dc:creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
item.content:encoded: Elena Rybakina superó otro gran obstáculo en su camino hacia un tercer título de Grand Slam al imponerse con claridad a la excampeona del Abierto de Estados Unidos Naomi Osaka, por 6-1 y 6-4, este lunes, lo que le valió el pase a cuartos de final en Flushing Meadows. La impecable victoria de Rybakina, ganadora de Wimbledon en 2022 y del Abierto de Australia de este año, le valió un enfrentamiento en cuartos de final con la campeona olímpica Zheng Qinwen y dejó a la kazaja a un solo partido de convertirse en número uno del mundo por primera vez. "Por supuesto que lo quiero. No conozco a nadie que no lo desee. Sin duda, es uno de mis objetivos", dijo Rybakina poco después de alcanzar sus primeros cuartos de final en Nueva York. "Intentaré afrontar (el partido) de la misma manera y darlo todo. Lucharé hasta el final en mi próximo partido. Ya veremos qué pasa", añadió. "Si saco tan bien como lo he hecho hoy, creo que tengo todas las posibilidades. Lo daré todo. Espero que las cosas me salgan bien". Rybakina, segunda cabeza de serie, se llevó el primer set en 22 minutos, aprovechando dos de sus tres oportunidades de break antes de cerrarlo con un potente servicio que dejó contra las cuerdas a Osaka, dos veces campeona de Nueva York, en el estadio Louis Armstrong. Osaka, cabeza de serie número 13, opuso mayor resistencia al principio del segundo set, pero Rybakina pronto recuperó el control. Osaka se agarró la pierna izquierda con el marcador 2-2 en el segundo set, ya que aún notaba los efectos de una molestia en el tendón de Aquiles que se agravó en la tercera ronda, pero la jugadora de 28 años logró salvar un punto de break y mantenerse en la lucha. Rybakina siguió presionando a Osaka con sus potentes golpes de fondo y consiguió el quiebre de servicio decisivo en el séptimo juego, cuando su rival japonesa envió un golpe de derecha a la red, antes de cerrar el partido en tan solo 66 minutos.

item.title: イスラエルによるガザのがれき撤去で「犯罪証拠」隠滅の恐れ＝国連報告者
item.description:
Emma Farge
[ジュネーブ ７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Emma Farge

[ジュネーブ ７日 ロイター] - パレスチナ自治区ガザの人権状況に関する国連特別報告者のフランチェスカ・アルバネーゼ氏は７日、イスラエルによるガザのがれき撤去作業が、「残虐な犯罪」の貴重な証拠を隠滅し、遺体の回収を妨げる恐れがあるとする声明を発表した。

国連によると、２０２３年１０月にイスラム組織ハマスがイスラエル南部に奇襲を仕掛けたことをきっかけに始まったイスラエルによるガザへの攻撃で約６１００万トンのがれきが発生しており、その撤去には７年かかる可能性がある。

アルバネーゼ氏は、全面的な撤去作業を開始する前に、証拠の収集と遺体の身元確認を行うべきだと指摘。廃棄物の撤去計画はパレスチナ側が主導すべきだとした。

同氏は「壊滅的な被害を受けたガザにおいて、がれきは単なる建設廃棄物ではない。それは犯罪現場の一部であり、墓地であり、２年間にわたって続いた残忍で無意味な爆撃作戦の間に何が起きたかを示す物的証拠なのだ」と述べた。

また、イスラエル企業ががれき撤去に関与していることを複数の情報源から確認したと述べたが、情報源は明かさなかった。

イスラエルの外務省、首相官邸、および軍は、コメント要請に直ちには回答しなかった。

イスラエル側の集計によると、２３年のハマス主導の奇襲攻撃により、イスラエル国内で１２００人が死亡し、さらに２５１人が人質に取られた。

ガザの保健当局によると、イスラエルの軍事作戦により７万３０００人以上のパレスチナ人が死亡した。

イスラエルは、民間人の犠牲を避けるために多大な努力を払ってきたとし、ハマスが人口密集地域でガザの民間人を人間の盾として利用していると主張しているが、ハマスはこれを否定している。

ハマスは声明の中で、アルバネーゼ氏の警告に謝意を示すとともに、行方不明者の遺体の回収と証拠の保全が確保される方法でがれきの撤去を行うよう求めた。

パレスチナ当局の推計では、８０００人以上が依然としてがれきの下に埋もれている。

ドイツ、フランス、イタリアの３カ国は２月、アルバネーゼ氏がイスラエルに対して過度に否定的だと非難した。米国は昨年７月、アルバネーゼ氏が国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）に対し、米国およびイスラエルの政府高官、企業、経営幹部に対する措置を講じるよう働きかけたとして、同氏に制裁を課した。

国連の専門家たちは、ジュネーブに本部を置く人権理事会から、特定の人権危機を監視・記録するよう委嘱されているが、国連自体からは独立している。

item.title: イラン、湾岸の米エネルギー資産に報復警告 攻撃続けば標的も
item.description:
Nayera Abdallah Eman Abouhassira
[ドバイ ７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nayera Abdallah　Eman Abouhassira

[ドバイ ７日 ロイター] - イランは７日、自国資産が米国による新たな攻撃を受ければ報復すると述べ、米国の石油・ガス権益を含む湾岸全域のエネルギーインフラが標的になり得ると警告した。

先週末に両国が互いにタンカーを攻撃したことを受け、イランのガリバフ国会議長は「われわれの資産を攻撃すれば、そちらも攻撃されることになる」と述べた。

同氏はその後、Ｘに「単純な話だ。この地域の石油・ガス生産網は広範に広がり、接近しやすく、無防備な状態にある。この海域や関連施設に展開する米国の石油・ガス企業も同様に無防備だ」と投稿した。ヘグセス米国防長官がイランの石油タンカーを「無防備」と評したことへの反論とみられる。

イラン最高安全保障委員会のレザイ事務局長は６日、ペルシャ湾に近く新たな制限区域を設定し、ホルムズ海峡を通る新たな航路を発表すると明らかにした。

レザイ氏によると、制限区域は米国によるイラン海上封鎖の起点から始まり、ペルシャ湾の一部海域に及ぶ。区域に進入する船舶はイランの制裁リストに掲載されるという。

同氏は「米国がイランに対する破壊工作、脅し、攻撃をやめて初めて、われわれはホルムズ海峡の開放を約束する」と述べた。

item.title: EverBank to combine with WaFd in $3.9 billion reverse merger
item.description: Florida-based EverBank Financial has agreed to acquire WaFd , a smaller bank in the Pacific Northwest, in a $3.9 billion reverse merger transaction, the companies said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Florida-based EverBank Financial has agreed to acquire WaFd (WAFD.O) , a smaller bank in the Pacific Northwest, in a $3.9 billion reverse merger transaction, the companies said on Monday. The deal would create a regional bank with some $75 billion in assets, the Wall Street Journal reported earlier on Monday, citing a statement from the companies. Under the deal, EverBank will merge into WaFd, with the latter remaining a publicly traded company after changing its name to EverBank Financial Corp and trading under the new ticker symbol EVBK on the Nasdaq. Upon completion of the transaction, EverBank investors will collectively own about 59.2% of the pro forma combined company, with WaFd shareholders owning the remaining 40.8%. The companies said the merger, which is expected to close in early 2027, is projected to increase WaFd's 2027 earnings per share by roughly 29% and recoup tangible book value dilution in less than two years.

item.title: D-backs score five in 10th, then hold off Royals
item.description: Pinch hitter Lars Nootbaar's sacrifice fly scored automatic runner Corbin Carroll to snap a scoreless tie in the 10th inning as the visiting Arizona Diamondbacks hung on for a 5-4 victory over the Kansas City Royals on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Pinch hitter Lars Nootbaar's sacrifice fly scored automatic runner Corbin Carroll to snap a scoreless tie in the 10th inning as the visiting Arizona Diamondbacks hung on for a 5-4 victory over the Kansas City Royals on Monday. Gabriel Moreno, Nolan Arenado and Ildemaro Vargas each had two hits for the D-backs (77-68). Salvador Perez was 3-for-5 with a double and three RBIs, and Vinnie Pasquantino added two hits for the Royals (64-81). Justin Martinez (2-0) earned the win, throwing a scoreless ninth with one walk and one strikeout. Dennis Santana earned his third save, striking out one during a perfect two-thirds of an inning in the 10th. Vargas' bunt single off Royals reliever Craig Kimbrel (1-4) advanced Carroll to third to open the 10th before Nootbaar's sacrifice fly to deep center gave the D-backs a 1-0 advantage. Adrian Del Castillo popped out in foul territory and Ryan Waldschmidt singled to give Arizona runners at first and second. Geraldo Perdomo then singled to right, and Vargas and Waldschmidt both scored on John Rave's fielding error for a 3-0 lead. After the Royals intentionally walked Ketel Marte, Moreno and Arenado connected on consecutive run-scoring singles off Kimbrel for a 5-0 advantage. The Royals answered with a four-run 10th. Kyle Isbel walked to open the frame, and Carter Jensen followed with a double to plate automatic runner Isaac Collins. Bobby Witt Jr. was then hit by a pitch to load the bases against reliever Gerardo Carrillo. Pasquantino struck out swinging before Perez's three-run double cleared the bases to pull the Royals within 5-4. Santana relieved Carrillo and coaxed Michael Massey to fly out to center, allowing pinch runner Tyler Tolbert to tag and advance to third with the game-tying run. But Nick Loftin struck out looking to end the game. Royals starter Noah Cameron threw six scoreless innings, scattering three hits, walking two and fanning seven. Arizona threatened in the ninth when Marte led off with a seeing-eye single. Moreno singled through the right side with the hit-and-run on, allowing Marte to advance to third. Arenado ripped a line drive that a diving Loftin speared at third base before quickly reaching out to touch third and double off Marte. Royals reliever Steven Cruz then fanned Carroll. --Field Level Media

item.title: Zheng hangs on through career roller coaster at US Open
item.description: Zheng Qinwen rode a roller coaster ride of highs and lows into the U.S. Open quarter-finals on Monday, upsetting major winners Madison Keys and Iga Swiatek in back-to-back matches in the start of an epic career comeback.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Zheng Qinwen rode a roller coaster ride of highs and lows into the U.S. Open quarter-finals on Monday, upsetting major winners Madison Keys and Iga Swiatek in back-to-back matches in the start of an epic career comeback. China's Zheng had everything working in her favour two years ago, with the Olympic gold around her neck, a maiden major final at the Australian Open and a spot in the top 10. But a chronic elbow injury brought her progress to a screeching halt, as she bounced out of Wimbledon in the first round in 2025 before undergoing surgery. After a grim 2026 season littered with early exits, including first-round defeats at the French Open and the All England Club, she tumbled to 121st in the rankings and was forced to go through qualifying in New York. "Psychologically, it is very difficult to accept. I mean, I used to be top 10, Olympic champion. I play in the big stadiums since the beginning," said Zheng. "I know people have a lot of doubt about me, and it's just really hard for me. I just need to keep positive every single day, telling myself, 'Just keep working, and let's see when the result gonna happen'. "It is a really, really tough process. I suffered a lot, and I have been through a lot of pain every single losses I have. But I think at the end, sport, you just needs to stay humble and keep fighting, because once you lost that, the result really shows everything." The power of her positive thinking has been on full display in New York. She overcame a 0-5 deficit in the decisive set against 2017 finalist Keys in the [USN:L6N44X041 TEXT:"third round"], and she slew another dragon in Swiatek in [USN:L6N44Z0TK TEXT:"the fourth"], overcoming a 0-5 deficit in the opening set. She credited the turnaround in form, in part to a last-minute training block she and her coach squeezed in after another dreadful pre-tournament defeat in the first round of qualifying in Toronto. "My coach sat down with me and we had a long talk together. He told me, 'You can't continue playing like this. You need to have a training block'," said Zheng. "It was really tough, but this is how sport shows. If you don't work hard, you don't have it. So I'm really happy about we make together the work, and then at the end, the effort pays off." Zheng will play second seed Elena Rybakina next. "I'm just really happy to be back again," she told reporters. "I mean, if that's what God gives to me, all the losses before, I'm sure that he will give me something back, no?"

item.title: Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro, en empate en una segunda vuelta en Brasil, según encuesta de Quaest
item.description: El presidente brasileño Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y el senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro están empatados para una posible segunda vuelta de las elecciones de octubre, según una encuesta de Quaest, encargada por Globo y publicada el lunes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente brasileño Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y el senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro están empatados para una posible segunda vuelta de las elecciones de octubre, según una encuesta de Quaest, encargada por Globo y publicada el lunes. En una segunda vuelta simulada, Lula obtuvo el 41% de los votos, empatado con el 41% del hijo mayor del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro. Una encuesta de Quaest publicada el 2 de septiembre había mostrado a Lula con una ventaja de 42% sobre 41% ante Bolsonaro. Quaest encuestó a 2.004 personas entre el 3 y el 6 de septiembre. La encuesta tiene un margen de error de 2 puntos porcentuales.

item.title: Lula e Flávio aparecem empatados em 41% no segundo turno, diz Quaest
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) estão empatados com 41% das intenções de voto em um eventual segundo turno da eleição presidencial, mostrou pesquisa Quaest divulgada nesta segunda-feira, segundo o jornal O Globo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) estão empatados com 41% das intenções de voto em um eventual segundo turno da eleição presidencial, mostrou pesquisa Quaest divulgada nesta segunda-feira, segundo o jornal O Globo. Na pesquisa anterior, divulgada na semana passada, Lula aparecia com 42% e Flávio somava 41%. A nova pesquisa foi contratada pela TV Globo e pelo jornal O Globo. No primeiro turno, Lula aparece com 36%, ante 37% na pesquisa anterior, enquanto Flávio manteve-se em 29%; Augusto Cury (Avante) tem 8%, ante 10% na pesquisa anterior. Nenhum outro candidato ultrapassa a marca de 3%. A Quaest ouviu 2.004 pessoas entre os dias 3 e 6 de setembro. A margem de erro é de 2 pontos percentuais.

item.title: Rybakina thumps Osaka to reach US Open quarters, close in on top ranking
item.description: Elena Rybakina cleared another big hurdle in her bid to win a third Grand Slam title by outclassing former U.S. Open champion Naomi Osaka 6-1 6-4 on Monday to reach the quarter-finals at Flushing Meadows.
item.dc:creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
item.content:encoded: Elena Rybakina cleared another big hurdle in her bid to win a third Grand Slam title by outclassing former U.S. Open champion Naomi Osaka 6-1 6-4 on Monday to reach the quarter-finals at Flushing Meadows. The flawless victory for Rybakina, who won Wimbledon in 2022 and this year's Australian Open, booked a last-eight clash with Olympic champion Zheng Qinwen and left the Kazakh one match win away from becoming world number one for the first time. "Of course I want it. I don't know anyone who wouldn't wish for it. It's definitely one of my goals," said Rybakina, shortly after reaching her maiden quarter-finals in New York. "I'll try to approach (the match) the same way and try to do everything I can. Fight till the end in my next match. Let's see what's going to happen. "If I serve as well as I did today, I think I have all the chances. I'll try my best. Hopefully it's going to go my way." Second seed Rybakina raced through the opening set in 22 minutes, converting two of her three break-point opportunities before sealing it with a booming serve to leave two-times New York champion Osaka on the ropes at Louis Armstrong Stadium. "I didn't expect that. I thought I played really well, I was feeling the ball well," added Rybakina. "Naomi's a tough opponent. I knew that no matter the score I needed to focus on each ball as everything can change quickly. "She's a very aggressive player, so I'm so glad about the way I played today." The 13th-seeded Osaka, who had arrived in style in a fur-collared overcoat that featured oversized signage, a mural-like city scene and a portrait, showed greater resistance early in the second set, but Rybakina soon seized control again. Osaka clutched her left leg at 2-2 in the second set, still feeling the effects of an Achilles niggle that flared up in the third round, but the 28-year-old managed to save a break point and stay in the fight. Rybakina continued to heap pressure on Osaka with her deep groundstrokes and earned the decisive break in the seventh game when her Japanese opponent hit a forehand into the net, before she closed out the match in only 66 minutes.

item.title: Colts WR Alec Pierce (ankle) ‘should be good’ for Week 1
item.description: Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Alec Pierce is in line to play Week 1 against the Baltimore Ravens after missing most of the offseason due to ankle surgery.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Alec Pierce is in line to play Week 1 against the Baltimore Ravens after missing most of the offseason due to ankle surgery. "He should be good to go," Colts coach Shane Steichen told reporters Monday. "We'll get him some reps and practice this week, just like he took reps last week. He's feeling really good." Pierce underwent surgery on his left ankle in March and only returned to practice on Aug. 27. He did not appear in a preseason game, and per reports, Monday marked just Pierce's fifth practice since being cleared. Pierce, 26, enters his fifth NFL season as the Colts' No. 1 wideout after he set career highs of 47 receptions and 1,003 yards last year. He added six touchdowns and has 157 catches for 2,934 yards and 17 touchdowns in 64 games (55 starts) since being taken in the second round of the 2022 draft. A deep threat, Pierce has led the NFL for two straight seasons in yards per catch, coming in at 21.3 yards per reception last year. Pierce signed a four-year, $114 million contract extension with Indianapolis in March. --Field Level Media

item.title: Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro tied in Brazil's election runoff, Quaest poll shows
item.description: Brazilian leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing challenger Senator Flavio Bolsonaro are tied in a potential second-round runoff in October's election, a Quaest poll commissioned by Globo showed on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazilian leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing challenger Senator Flavio Bolsonaro are tied in a potential second-round runoff in October's election, a Quaest poll commissioned by Globo showed on Monday. In a simulated runoff, Lula would win 41% of the vote against 41% for the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro. A Quaest poll released on September 2 had Lula leading Bolsonaro 42% to 41%. Quaest surveyed 2,004 people between September 3-6. The poll has a margin of error of 2 percentage points.

item.title: Revés da Novartis em colesterol testa esperanças de novos medicamentos para doenças cardíacas
item.description: As ações da Novartis caíram mais de 3% nesta segunda-feira, depois que o medicamento para o colesterol da empresa não obteve sucesso em um estudo muito aguardado, representando um revés para o que os investidores consideravam um tratamento de grande sucesso e aumentando a pressão sobre os próximos dados de uma terapia contra a atrofia muscular adquirida com a compra da Avidity pela farmacêutica suíça por US$12 bilhões.
item.dc:creator: Bhanvi Satija
item.content:encoded: As ações da Novartis (NOVN.S) caíram mais de 3% nesta segunda-feira, depois que o medicamento para o colesterol da empresa não obteve sucesso em um estudo muito aguardado, representando um revés para o que os investidores consideravam um tratamento de grande sucesso e aumentando a pressão sobre os próximos dados de uma terapia contra a atrofia muscular adquirida com a compra da Avidity pela farmacêutica suíça por US$12 bilhões. Os investidores contavam com o pelacarsen, o medicamento anti-inflamatório remibrutinibe e a terapia de RNA del-desiran para impulsionar o crescimento, à medida que a Novartis se prepara para o vencimento das patentes de seus antigos sucessos de vendas, incluindo o medicamento cardíaco Entresto. O revés também gera incerteza sobre o esforço mais amplo do setor para combater a lipoproteína (a), ou Lp(a), um fator de risco cardiovascular hereditário para o qual ainda não há tratamentos aprovados. A Amgen <AMGEN. O> e a Eli Lilly (LLY.N) estão realizando ensaios clínicos em fase avançada de medicamentos experimentais concorrentes, o olpasiran e o lepodisiran. No final da sexta-feira, a Novartis informou que [USN:L4N44W1DB TEXT:"seu medicamento pelacarsen"] não reduziu o risco de ataque cardíaco e derrame em um grande estudo em fase avançada com pacientes com níveis elevados de Lp(a). Analistas haviam previsto vendas anuais máximas entre US$3 bilhões e US$6 bilhões caso o medicamento se mostrasse bem-sucedido. GRANDES EXPECTATIVAS PARA MEDICAMENTO CONTRA DOENÇA RARA O foco agora estará nos resultados de um estudo em fase avançada de sua terapia de RNA, o del-desiran, no quarto trimestre. O medicamento, que trata uma doença muscular rara, foi adquirido por meio da compra da Avidity, e analistas do Barclays afirmaram que o sucesso nesse ensaio “é necessário para justificar” o alto preço. Também são esperados ainda este ano os dados de outro estudo do medicamento anti-inflamatório remibrutinibe, da Novartis, em pacientes com uma condição cutânea chamada hidradenite supurativa. O medicamento obteve sucesso em um ensaio clínico com pacientes com esclerose múltipla na semana passada. Analistas da Jefferies afirmaram que o recente sucesso do medicamento para esclerose múltipla “deveria tornar a conclusão do estudo com o pelacarsen mais aceitável” para os investidores. Até o fechamento do mercado na sexta-feira, as ações da Novartis valorizaram cerca de um quinto neste ano, impulsionadas pelo otimismo em relação ao seu pipeline. Analistas do Barclays afirmaram que o segundo medicamento da Novartis, o DII235, direcionado ao Lp(a), agora parece “improvável que traga qualquer benefício significativo”. (Reportagem de Bhanvi Satija; Edição de Joe Bavier e Louise Heavens)

item.title: Bill Belichick avoids investigation questions, touts UNC's 'high standard'
item.description: North Carolina head coach Bill Belichick was guarded in his first public comments since Michael Lombardi stepped down as Tar Heels football general manager last week, saying the staff has been able to hold players "accountable."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: North Carolina head coach Bill Belichick was guarded in his first public comments since Michael Lombardi stepped down as Tar Heels football general manager last week, saying the staff has been able to hold players "accountable." Lombardi's resignation came after a complaint had been filed against him by a former North Carolina employee through the university's human resources department. He had been on paid leave since the complaint was filed, ESPN reported in July. Soon after the complaint against Lombardi was reported, Tar Heels defensive coordinator Steve Belichick, Bill's son, was placed on medical leave. WRAL News in Raleigh, N.C., reported last week that Steve Belichick was being investigated for allegations of using "drugs on the job." The report said he was also under investigation for allegedly providing "drugs to at least one player." Investigators are also probing whether members of the recruiting staff have had improper relationships with players and assistant coaches, according to the report. "I understand the importance of the work that's being done by the investigative team," Belichick said Monday at his weekly press conference. "Obviously our high standard here -- our code of conduct and doing things the right way and making sure that our student-athletes are given the utmost, the best treatment, the very best care, and the very best coaching that we can possibly give them. So, that's critically important to us." Belichick, who touted the program's code of conduct, was asked if cultural changes needed to be made within the program. "No. I have an ongoing relationship, communication with the university, and they've been very supportive. A great working relationship with those people," he said. "In the end, we want to run the program in the very best way. And if there's things we need to do to correct it, then we'll obviously do them." North Carolina is 1-0 this season after a 15-10 upset over TCU on Aug. 29 in Dublin, Ireland. The Tar Heels play host to East Tennessee State on Saturday. The Tar Heels were a disappointing 4-8 last season, Belichick's first at the helm of the program. --Field Level Media

item.title: Em ato na Paulista, Flávio busca vincular Lula a Moraes e promete recuperar credibilidade do Judiciário
item.description: O senador e candidato à Presidência Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) buscou vincular o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) ao ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), durante discurso em ato na Avenida Paulista, em São Paulo, pelo Dia da Independência e prometeu que, se eleito, recuperará a credibilidade do Judiciário brasileiro.
item.dc:creator: Eduardo Simões, Gabriel Araujo
item.content:encoded: O senador e candidato à Presidência Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) buscou vincular o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) ao ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), durante discurso em ato na Avenida Paulista, em São Paulo, pelo Dia da Independência e prometeu que, se eleito, recuperará a credibilidade do Judiciário brasileiro. Em um ato cujo mote foi "fora Lula e fora Moraes", Flávio também disse que vencerá a eleição presidencial já no primeiro turno, marcado para daqui a menos de um mês em 4 de outubro, e disse que quer ser "o libertador da pátria". Pesquisas Datafolha e Quaest mostraram na semana passada Lula liderando o primeiro turno e um empate técnico entre ele e Flávio no segundo turno, com vantagem numérica para o petista. "Primeiramente, fora Lula, fora Moraes", disse Flávio ao iniciar o seu discurso para milhares de pessoas que foram à Avenida Paulista apesar do frio de cerca de 12 ºC e do tempo fechado na capital paulista nesta segunda. "Esse consórcio de Lula com Moraes vai acabar", afirmou o filho mais velho do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro. "Quem vota em Lula está votando em Alexandre de Moraes. Nós não vamos permitir que o Lula indique mais quatro Alexandres de Moraes para o Supremo Tribunal Federal. Eu vou indicar cinco ministros para o Supremo Tribunal Federal, porque Alexandre de Moraes vai cair." Moraes tomou posse como ministro do STF em 2017, indicado pelo então presidente Michel Temer, que assumiu após o impeachment da petista Dilma Rousseff. Durante o governo Bolsonaro, o ministro foi alvo constante de críticas de Jair Bolsonaro, que, assim como fez Flávio nesta segunda, usou atos no 7 de Setembro na Paulista para atacar o magistrado. Em 2021, Bolsonaro chamou Moraes de "canalha" e disse que não cumpriria suas decisões. Em 2023, Moraes foi o relator do processo em que Bolsonaro foi condenado por tentativa de golpe de Estado e outros crimes. Atualmente, o ex-presidente cumpre prisão domiciliar devido a condições de saúde. As críticas contra Moraes ganharam corpo nos últimos dias depois que o ministro do STF André Mendonça liberou sigilo de relatório da Polícia Federal mostrando mensagens de Daniel Vorcaro, do Master, para ele nas quais o banqueiro questiona se Moraes poderia reverter investigações contra ele. Além disso, Vorcaro tinha um contrato de cerca de R$130 milhões com o escritório de advocacia de Viviane Barci de Moraes, esposa do ministro. Em seu discurso, Flávio chamou Moraes de "laranja podre" e disse que sua presença na corte não pode contaminar o tribunal. "Eu vou trabalhar para resgatar a credibilidade do Judiciário brasileiro. Nós temos que proteger o STF de Alexandre de Moraes. Aquela laranja podre não pode contaminar toda a corte. O Supremo não é Alexandre de Moraes, o Judiciário não é Alexandre de Moraes. A magistratura não é Alexandre de Moraes", afirmou. Sem entrar em detalhes, Flávio também fez questão de mandar um recado aos que, segundo ele, querem interferir nas eleições. Ao lembrar que, na véspera, completaram-se oito anos do atentado a faca sofrido por seu pai durante a campanha eleitoral de 2018, o senador disse que a condenação por golpe de Estado foi uma "segunda facada" e que uma terceira está a caminho. "Eu estou avisando, vão tentar uma terceira facada não só em mim, mas também em meus aliados. E o que eu tenho a dizer a vocês que vão tentar mais uma vez interferir nas eleições: não vai adiantar nada, porque eu estou aqui de peito aberto e nós juntos somos muito mais fortes do que eles", disse. Recentemente Flávio realizou uma reunião com diplomatas para, sem evidências, levantar dúvidas em relação ao sistema eleitoral brasileiro, recorrendo inclusive a informações já conhecidamente falsas. Uma das condenações à inelegibilidade de Jair Bolsonaro se deve a uma reunião com embaixadores em 2022 para atacar as urnas eletrônicas. No comício desta tarde, Flávio reafirmou, como já havia feito recentemente em entrevista à TV Globo, que vencerá a eleição no primeiro turno. "Eu quero ser o libertador da pátria", disse.

item.title: Jackson Chourio sparks Brewers’ comeback win over Cubs
item.description: Jackson Chourio singled in two runs to key an eighth-inning rally and help lift the Milwaukee Brewers to a 4-3 comeback victory over the visiting Chicago Cubs on Monday in the opener of a showdown series between the top two teams in the National League Central.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jackson Chourio singled in two runs to key an eighth-inning rally and help lift the Milwaukee Brewers to a 4-3 comeback victory over the visiting Chicago Cubs on Monday in the opener of a showdown series between the top two teams in the National League Central. Held to one run through seven innings by starter Matthew Boyd (8-4), the Brewers scored three in the eighth to go in front 4-2. Garrett Mitchell walked to open the bottom of the frame and Joey Ortiz doubled to left, chasing Boyd. Ryan Zeferjahn relieved Boyd, and the first batter he faced, Chourio, punched a two-run single through the right side. After Zeferjahn walked Brice Turang and William Contreras struck out, he was relieved by Jacob Webb, who walked pinch-hitter Jake Bauers to load the bases. Christian Yelich followed with a sacrifice fly to make it 4-2. Pete Crow-Armstrong brought Chicago within 4-3 in the ninth with his 41st homer, a two-out solo shot off Trevor Megill. Megill recovered to convert his 19th consecutive save opportunity and earn his 27th save in 29 chances. Milwaukee (89-56), seeking its fourth consecutive division title, moved eight games ahead of the second-place Cubs (81-64) in the division. The Brewers entered Monday 1 1/2 games in front of the Dodgers for the best record in the majors. The Cubs went in front 2-1 with a two-out rally in the seventh off Aaron Ashby. Crow-Armstrong singled with two outs and took second with his 35th stolen base before Suzuki walked. Alex Bregman followed with a run-scoring single to center. Pedro Ramirez broke a scoreless tie with his fifth homer, lining a 1-1 pitch from starter Robert Gasser 407 feet to left with two outs in the fifth. Crow-Armstrong then was hit by a pitch, stole second, and Suzuki walked. Chad Patrick relieved and retired Bregman on an inning-ending foul pop to first. The Brewers answered with the tying run in the bottom half of the fifth when Luis Lara singled to open, advanced on a sacrifice bunt and scored on Garrett Mitchell's single to center. --Field Level Media

item.title: Entregas de aeronaves da Airbus aumentam 9% no ano até agosto
item.description: As entregas de jatos da Airbus aumentaram 9% nos primeiros oito meses de 2026, mantendo a fabricante europeia de aeronaves no caminho certo para cumprir sua meta anual, embora a empresa ainda precise recuperar parte do atraso nas entregas do modelo A330 após um problema na produção, segundo dados divulgados nesta segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As entregas de jatos da Airbus (AIR.PA) aumentaram 9% nos primeiros oito meses de 2026, mantendo a fabricante europeia de aeronaves no caminho certo para cumprir sua meta anual, embora a empresa ainda precise recuperar parte do atraso nas entregas do modelo A330 após um problema na produção, segundo dados divulgados nesta segunda-feira. A Airbus informou em um boletim mensal que entregou 475 jatos entre janeiro e agosto, contra 434 no mesmo período do ano passado. O total incluiu 57 entregas em agosto. Dados divulgados pela empresa sediada na França mostraram que as entregas do jato de fuselagem larga A330 foram retomadas com uma entrega em agosto, após terem sido suspensas em junho e julho devido à [USN:L1N44V0ES TEXT:"descoberta de uma ferramenta perdida"] na seção da cauda de um A330. A Airbus já entregou 11 A330s neste ano, uma queda de 31%. As entregas da família A320 de corredor único, referência no setor, aumentaram 11%. A empresa tem como meta 870 entregas em 2026, um aumento de 10% em relação às 793 do ano passado. A fabricante de aeronaves vendeu 67 aeronaves em agosto, incluindo oito cargueiros A350F para um cliente não divulgado. Até agora, neste ano, ela vendeu 1.157 jatos, ou 1.091 após o ajuste para cancelamentos. (Reportagem de Tim Hepher)

item.title: Padres Opening Day starter Nick Pivetta back in action vs. Nationals
item.description: Padres Opening Day starter Nick Pivetta will take the mound for the first time in nearly five months when San Diego hosts the Washington Nationals on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Padres Opening Day starter Nick Pivetta will take the mound for the first time in nearly five months when San Diego hosts the Washington Nationals on Monday. The Padres activated the right-handed Pivetta off the 60-day injured list on Monday after he recovered from an elbow flexor strain in his pitching arm. Pivetta went 0-0 with a 3.38 ERA in three rehab appearances - two outings (one start) at Class A Lake Elsinore and one start for Triple-A El Paso -- but pitched just eight total innings. Pivetta will certainly be on a pitch count against Washington. In fact, Padres manager Craig Stammen said right-hander Randy Vasquez will be available in case of a short outing. Pivetta, 33, was hurt in his fourth start of the season, leaving the game while pitching to the leadoff batter in the fourth inning against the Colorado Rockies on April 12. He is 1-2 with a 4.50 ERA. In 2025, Pivetta was San Diego's best pitcher and posted career bests in wins (13), ERA (2.87), WHIP (0.99), innings (181 2/3) and strikeouts (190). The Padres have been bracing for Pivetta's return and filled a couple of holes in their rotation by acquiring San Francisco Giants left-hander Robbie Ray and Detroit Tigers right-hander Casey Mize at the trade deadline. In addition, right-hander Joe Musgrove has had multiple setbacks while recovering from Tommy John surgery and is close to missing his second consecutive season. Overall, Pivetta owns a 70-78 record with a 4.47 ERA in 258 appearances (213 starts) for the Philadelphia Phillies (2017-20), Boston Red Sox (2020-24) and Padres. The Padres could part ways with Pivetta after this season because he spent more than 130 consecutive days on the IL. That development gives them the option of voiding the final two years and $32 million of his four-year, $55 million deal. San Diego optioned right-hander Jhony Brito to El Paso in a corresponding move and designated catcher Blake Hunt for assignment to open up a 40-man roster spot for Pivetta. Brito, 28, had a 3.00 ERA in five appearances covering nine innings this season. Hunt, 27, made two appearances for the Padres and struck out in all three at-bats. --Field Level Media

item.title: トランプ氏、ボンバルディア機の米販売禁止を警告－カナダと関税応酬
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国とカナダの貿易摩擦が激しさを増すなか、トランプ米大統領は7日、カナダのボンバルディアの航空機について、米国内での販売を禁止する可能性があると警告した。
トランプ氏は「ボンバルディアはもう米国で販売させない！」とSNSに投稿。「ボンバルディアの製品は十分な水準に達していない！
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国とカナダの貿易摩擦が激しさを増すなか、トランプ米大統領は7日、カナダのボンバルディアの航空機について、米国内での販売を禁止する可能性があると警告した。

トランプ氏は「ボンバルディアはもう米国で販売させない！」とSNSに投稿。「ボンバルディアの製品は十分な水準に達していない！ 売上高の50%以上を米国に依存している。同社は米国の買い手、企業、空港、サービスに支えられているものの、カナダは米国のすばらしい銀行や企業を締め出している」と書き込んだ。

カナダは8日、米国から輸入される数百品目に15－50%の関税を課す方針だ。カーニー首相には、カナダを対象とする米政権の新たな関税措置に対抗する狙いがある。

トランプ氏は、ボンバルディア製航空機に何らかの販売禁止措置を課すのか、輸入に新たな関税を設定するのかについて具体的には明らかにしなかった。ただ以前には、カナダが米国製ガルフストリーム機の認証を阻んでいると主張し、ボンバルディア機を標的にする可能性を示した経緯がある。

カナダ政府とボンバルディアはいずれも、コメント要請にすぐには応じなかった。米国は祝日で、ホワイトハウスからもすぐには回答を得られなかった。

原題：Trump Threatens to Bar Sale of Canadian Bombardier Jets in US（抜粋）

item.title: Coby Mayo goes deep twice, Orioles knock off Guardians
item.description: Coby Mayo homered twice and the Baltimore Orioles snapped a six-game losing streak by defeating the visiting Cleveland Guardians 6-4 on Monday afternoon to begin a three-game series.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Coby Mayo homered twice and the Baltimore Orioles snapped a six-game losing streak by defeating the visiting Cleveland Guardians 6-4 on Monday afternoon to begin a three-game series. Starting pitcher Trevor Rogers threw 7 1/3 strong innings, reaching the 10-win mark for the first time in his seven-year career. Mayo smashed his 20th home run with a solo shot in the third inning and drilled a two-run homer in the sixth for his first career multi-homer game. Mayo's three runs batted in along with two hits apiece from Samuel Basallo and Rece Hinds were a big part of the offense for the Orioles (70-75). Hinds was in his second game with Baltimore and notched his first big-league hit since April with the Cincinnati Reds. Steven Kwan and Jo Adell each had two hits and Nathaniel Lowe smashed a pinch-hit, three-run homer for the Guardians (73-72), who began a six-game road trip. Starter Joey Cantillo (9-9) took the loss as he was charged with four runs in 2 1/3 innings. Rogers (10-9), who was making his third start with a chance to get to 10 wins, gave up a single to Kwan to lead off the game. The Guardians didn't have another hit until the sixth. Rogers ended up allowing one run on six hits without a walk and six strikeouts. Andrew Kittredge gave up Lowe's blast in the ninth before Josh Walker entered to record the final out for his first career save. Baltimore's Dylan Beavers rapped a run-scoring double for a 1-0 lead in the second inning. Mayo's first homer of the day gave the Orioles more than one run for the first time in four games. They tacked on two more runs in the inning on bases-loaded walks to Blaze Alexander and Pete Alonso. The last two walks marked a rough beginning to reliever Franco Aleman's stint. Adell's two-out double in the sixth inning put the Guardians on the board. Mayo answered with his second homer in the bottom of the inning. --Field Level Media

item.title: Tres grupos internacionales presentan solicitud de precalificación para participar en construcción de segunda línea del Metro de la capital de Colombia
item.description: Tres consorcios internacionales presentaron propuestas para construir la segunda línea del metro de Bogotá, estimada en 34,9 billones de pesos (11.164 millones de dólares), cuyo contrato se firmaría en el segundo semestre del próximo año, informó el lunes el alcalde de la capital colombiana.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tres consorcios internacionales presentaron propuestas para construir la segunda línea del metro de Bogotá, estimada en 34,9 billones de pesos (11.164 millones de dólares), cuyo contrato se firmaría en el segundo semestre del próximo año, informó el lunes el alcalde de la capital colombiana. Dos de los consorcios son de Europa y uno de China. "Los precalificados avanzarán a la segunda fase, en la que deberán presentar sus propuestas económicas y técnicas hacia finales de 2026. El contrato y el acta de inicio se firmarían durante el segundo semestre de 2027", precisó el alcalde de Bogotá, Carlos Fernando Galán, citado en un comunicado. La Línea 2 tendrá 15,5 kilómetros de extensión y 11 estaciones, de las cuales 10 serán subterráneas y una elevada. Los siguientes son los consorcios: - APCA ML2 BOGOTÁ integrada por: Mota-Engil Colombia S.A.S.; Mota-Engil Engenharia e Construção África S.A., Mota-Engil México, S.A.P. I de C.V y Spie Batignolles Génie Civil. - APCA METRO CAPITAL L2 integrada por: Xi´an Metro Colombia S.A.S y Xi án Rail Transportation Group Company, ltd. - APCA APCA BOGOTÁ METRO CAPITAL integrada por: Sacyr Concesiones Colombia participadas II S.A.S y CAF Investement Projects. (1 dólar = 3.126 pesos)

item.title: Italy logs hottest summer for more than 75 years, institute says
item.description: Italy logs its hottest summer since 1950, with August smashing heat records and drought pressure rising in key farming regions.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Sustainability

Italy logs hottest summer for more than 75 years, institute says

Italy logs its hottest summer since 1950, with August smashing heat records and drought pressure rising in key farming regions.

A woman cools off with a fan near the Colosseum during a heatwave as temperatures are expected to rise further in the coming days, in Rome, Italy August 3, 2026. REUTERS/Remo Casilli
